config.conditions: no MC contention, H0 windows, single process, OPENBLAS 8 threads
config.note: post-D4 code path (ica_fix adopted); the §4.6 table was pre-D4-fix, measured inside the MC loop

complexity.Proposed: network (conv+LSTM, Np=512, 2 ch) + whiten/eigh O(Np^2) + anchored cICA (50 anchored iters + median 1 FastICA sweep post-D4) + C_sep solve O(Np^2) + steering-bank NMF max over Np bins
complexity.Delay warm: same as Proposed on the [x(t), x(t-1)] stack (2x input), retrained checkpoint
complexity.ANMF deployed: K=1024 secondary windows, unit-normalized; SCM O(K Np^2); C^-1 solve O(Np^3)~O(Np^2.4); GLRT rides along (<1 ms)
complexity.ANMF loaded/eigen: one shared eigh O(Np^3) per unit + per-variant diagonal re-weighting (no repeated solves)
complexity.CA/OS-CFAR: range-block O((2R+1) Np) sums + order-statistic sort over the training window (OS)

interpretation.text: post-D4: separation+NMF costs 243.6 ms/unit (was ~288 ms pre-D4, i.e. ~1x faster); network adds 29.0 ms; end-to-end Proposed 272.6 ms/unit, delay-warm 258.2; ANMF deployed 657.3 ms, loaded eigen path 4.9 ms; CA/OS-CFAR pair 19.1 ms
